scalar_audit.scope: Decoded ISO-extracted Browser operands and inspected floating-point/state mnemonics only; no runtime stack/register/cache-erasure, scheduler, hostile containment or whole-image instruction proof.

limitations: Fixed deliberately public laboratory HTTPS root, expected name and BOOT endpoint only; no public Internet or general public-CA qualification.
Applied acknowledges historical display state publication, not current framebuffer pixels; selected native captures are independently checked and bound separately.
QOI decoding is bounded to 48 by 48 pixels and 12288 encoded bytes; this is not a general web-image or browser implementation.
No crash/power-loss, hostile containment, physical hardware, SMP, whole-stack/register/cache-erasure or full-system acceptance claim.
Fourteen raw image/absence frames have full source-bound pixel checks; two closed captures bind format/resolution and cleanup only, without glyph-erasure proof.

Native selected image layouts all use integer scale4; other supported fit factors/clipping and partial-upload live recreation are covered by actual-function tests, not a native resize-during-upload claim.
Canonical final host gates run on frozen F; failed earlier B/C/D/E attempts and diagnostics add no accepted native boots.
No latest-image sustained mixed-session acceptance, arbitrary URL/HTML/script support, general image size/format support, color-managed rendering or hard desktop-latency bound.

excluded_unbound_scope.native_disks: all regular native raw disks retained; explicit seed list retained independently

scope: GLOBAL_VAS addressing, BOOT-only capability genesis, sex-pdx runtime authority, PKU enforcement and exact terminal incarnations. SexOS is not Unix/POSIX. Round99 final qualification only; failed earlier99 candidates stay separate and supply no acceptance.
